spans.s: धुस्तु(स्तू)र m. Name of a plant, (the same as धत्तूर).
धुस्तु(स्तू)र m. Name of a plant, (the same as धत्तूर).
धूसर (I) a. (f. रा) Of a dusty colour, grey, R.v.42, xvi.17, K.S.iv.4.
धूसर (II) m. 1. The grey colour; 2. a donkey; 3. a camel; 4. a pigeon; 5. an oilman.
